name: TourBox NEO
summary: TourBox NEO - Accessories & Spare Parts - TourBox NEO New generation of a deeply-customizable creative software controller Compatible with Literally All Programs Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, Final Cut Pro X, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Captur
description_html:
TourBox NEO

New generation of a deeply-customizable

creative software controller

Compatible with Literally All Programs

Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, Final Cut Pro X, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Capture One, Clip Studio Paint, Paint Tool SAI, you name it!

Immerse yourself into the creation and increase the productivity by 40%!

Use With A Mouse Or Graphics Tablet.

Lightweight and durable, ergonomic design enables you to control with just one hand which sparing you the trouble of using complicated shortcut keys.

Makes Work Easy

Your Secret Weapon In All Programs


Illustration & Design

You can easily control the size, flow, transparency and hardness of the brush during drawing with a versatile knob, zoom in and out with a roll, or drag images by pressing a button.

All these controls can be achieved singlehanded and no need to move your hand at all. Seamlessly with a mouse and a digital panel.


Video Editing

In Premiere Pro，Final Cut Pro X and DaVinci Resolve, no more inconvenience is brought by complicated keyboard shortcuts. Editing and toning become simple and efficient. The dial, knob, and scroll, along with buttons of different shapes, make the whole workflow of video editing and color grading more intuitive and efficient.


Whether it’s timeline fast-moving, frame by frame stepping, or timeline zooming in/out, you can do whatever you want with TourBox NEO.


Photo Editing

In Adobe Lightroom, you can easily adjust the exposure, contrast, shadows, highlights, and other parameters with just a simple turn of a knob.


Your eyes only need to focus on the changes in the image, and there’s no need to look at the parameter bar, which helps you focus on your creation entirely. You can even lie in bed to accomplish your work.


Customize your creativity in the way you want with the powerful TourBox Console application

In-depth design for various Application Scenarios Whether it is brush control, image control, parameter adjust, or tool switching, you can use TourBox NEO in creative software in an incredibly intuitive, faster,more efficient, and seamless way.



Powerful

Customizable System

You can map your desired shortcuts of keyboards or mouse to TourBox NEO regarding the requirements of the different creative software.


The wheels (scroll, dial, and knob) and buttons can be used either individually or in multiple combinations to achieve 50 different operations


Equipped with Unique Built-in Functions

TourBox NEO has developed massive and unique built-in functions targeting various software.


These built-in functions can be configured on TourBox NEO, providing functions that the keyboard and mouse cannot achieve.


Anyone can use the device easily in no time.

TourBox NEO designed a series of thoughtful easy-to-use features, whether you

are a beginner or an expert, you can quickly and easily master it.


Prompt System

An interactive HUD on screen and the visual navigation map free you from the need to remember complicated functions! The unique shaped buttons on TourBox also enable you to access these functions with a simple touch.


Tag System

Editing software should come with easy-to-read label shortcuts that illustrate its functions. Now say goodbye to hard-to-remember shortcuts and enjoy TourBox's powerful, intuitive tag system instead.


Streamlined & Ergonomic Design

Reduces the fatigue of high-intensity creative work.


Fine Manufacturing

Tightly selected manufacturing process and ergonomic design let it fit perfectly in the palm of your hand. With 200,000 times of durability tests, it is not an electronic toy, but a real tool for creators.

Solid and reliable

The right weight makes it stable and not move with ease, allowing you to operate confidently.


Skin-friendly

Made out of skin-friendly materials and comfortable to hold.

description_html_ar:
جهاز TourBox NEO المبتكر لزيادة إنتاجيتك، يعمل مع جميع البرامج التي تحتاج إلى اختصارات لوحة المفاتيح.

انسيابي قابل للتخصيص.

تحكم بسهولة أكثر في البرامج مع وحدة تحكم تحرير الصور والفيديو، والـ 3D وتخلص من عناء استخدام مفاتيح الاختصار المعقدة حيث يمكنك استخدام تروبوكس بيد واحدة فقط، مع الماوس، أو لوحة المفاتيح، أو الجرافيك تابلت، أو شاشات الرسم.

 قوية وأنيقة. 

تتميز بالتصميم المريح وخفة وزنها مع خامتها وجودتها العالية، وقوتها حيث أنها خضعت لـ 200000 مرة من اختبارات المتانة.

سهل الاستخدام.

تحكم في حجم الفرشاة أثناء الرسم، كما يمكنك التكبير والتصغير بسهولة وضبط الإضاءة والتباين والظلال واستخدام كافة الاختصارات والتبديل بين الأدوات بكل مرونة. 

وصول أسرع. 

تحتوي وحدة تحكم تروبوكس على 11 مفتاح اختصار تخصصهم وفقاً لرغبتك، مع 3 بكرات دائرية يمكنك استخدامهم بشكل فردي أو في مجموعات لتحقيق 50 عملية اختصار مختلفة، كاختصارات لوحة المفاتيح أو وظائف مدمجة.



 

تُقدم وحدة التحكم تروبوكس نيو تجربة غير مسبوقة في الرسم والتصميم وتحرير الصور والفيديو و الصوت، تتوافق وحدة التحكم مع جميع البرامج :


Photoshop,Lightroom,Illustrator,Final Cut Pro X,Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve ,Capture One ,Clip Studio Pain, Paint Tool SAI 

 

*يمكنك استخدام وحدة التحكم من خلال تطبيق TourBox Console.

 

يتوافق جهاز التحكم مع أنظمة التشغيل :

MacOS 10.10,Windows 7 أو أحدث  


يتصل بجهاز الكمبيوتر من خلال USB-C ، مدعوم من جهاز الكمبيوتر الخاص بك.
